content: The corpus most comparable to ours is the French corpus of clinical case reports by grouin-etal-2019-clinical. Their annotations are based on UMLS semantic types. Even though there is an overlap in annotated entities, semantic classes are not the same. Lab results are subsumed under findings in our corpus and are not annotated as their own class. Factors extend beyond gender and age and describe any kind of risk factor that contributes to a higher probability of having a certain disease. Our corpus includes additional entity types. We annotate conditions, findings (including medical findings such as blood values), factors, and also modifiers which indicate the negation of other entities as well as case entities, i. e., entities specific to one case report. An overview is available in Table TABREF3.
